apps.address: Lot 736 (No.6) Caithness Road corner Peebles Road, Floreat
apps.quote: An application has been received for permission to operate a "bed and breakfast" at Lot 736 (No.6) Caithness Road corner Peebles Road, Floreat. The lot accommodates an existing single dwelling with four bedrooms (two storey) and attached ancillary accommodation unit with two bedrooms (single storey). The owners intend to use two upstairs bedrooms in the original dwelling for bed and breakfast accommodation (one room has a double bed and the other has a single bed).
